name: grant a request only if some completion order remains safe
mechanism: before granting a resource request, simulate granting it and check that the remaining processes can all finish in some order given their maximum claims; grant only if such an order exists

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Banker's algorithm' in section Operating systems algorithms: algorithm used for deadlock avoidance

fails_when: conservative: refuses requests that would have been fine
